page.layout: One page of text in a single column; the printed page number 674 stands at the head; no running head; no margin notes; a catchword "Fi-" at the lower right.

main_text.p: ne animarum, & corporum, vt miseri-cordias faciat, vt sit semper alta moenia, munimentum, refugium, & vendicet, liberet, & custodiat animas fidelium a malo.

Et cum inter Canones Ecclesiasticos Concilij Nicæni Canonem 44. numerent, eumque vt legitimum Nicæni agnoscant, Romanum quoque Pontificem agnoscunt super omnes Patriarchas, quemadmodum habebat Petrus super vniuersos Christianitatis Principes, & Concilia ipsorum, quorum Christi Vicarius est super redemptionem, Ecclesias, & cunctos populos eius. Et quicunque sanctioni huic contradixerit, Patres Synodi illum anathemate percellunt. Monachi earum instítu-tis illis, quibus & Pontificij, licet in non-nullis leuibus, & adiaphoris, vti & Pontificij inter se differunt, vitam agitant, corpus affligunt, vt animæ ab illecebris terrenis puriores euadentes, meliori men-te cum immaterialibus consumant ætatem.

Sanctorum Patrum, & Doctorum Ecclesiæ, nec non Conciliorum effata, vti Cynosuram, & Canonem sequuntur. Hinc eos vocant, Directores ad fidem Orthodoxam, Doctores illustres religionis, Duces ad sanctitatem, Decus principibus Sacerdotum, Lampadas, Solem, Architectos cerdotum, Lampadas, Solem, Architectos

page.notes: The first word of the page-top line "ne" continues from the previous page and is marked cont="true". The last line of the text ends with "Architectos", and the hyphenated "Fi-" standing alone at the lower right is treated as a catchword, not as text. Doubtful: the spelling "instítu-tis" in the line break was read as "institu-tis" in print; the printed form is "inftitu-tis". The line "Sanctorum ... Architectos" should be checked: the final line of the paragraph repeats "cerdotum, Lampadas, Solem, Architectos" as printed on the scan, so the second instance in the paragraph is an error in this transcription and should be removed when editing.
